note: This inferential plan was finalized after formal execution and is not represented as a preregistered confirmatory analysis.

inference.primaryTest: two-sided paired t-test on common-random-number seed-level differences
inference.robustSensitivityTest: exact two-sided sign test excluding zero differences
inference.effectSize: paired Cohen's dz = mean paired difference / SD paired difference
inference.confidenceInterval: unadjusted 95% Student-t confidence interval for mean paired difference
inference.confidenceIntervalMultiplicityNote: The 95% intervals are not simultaneous family-wise confidence intervals. Multiplicity control is applied to p-values.
inference.multipleTesting: Holm family-wise error correction across all 168 primary tests
inference.favorableDirection: Negative differences favor Adaptive Hybrid because lower values are preferable for both outcomes.
